`run` command end to end

Sluice: stream checkpoint weights into device memory from the weight manifest
Model IR: per-head rmsnorm attribute for Qwen3 QK norm

Kernel IR optimisation passes and the target capability model

GPU test: main (2108502) on gfx950 (MI350X)
GPU test: optimisation passes, LDS features and tune on gfx950 (PR #77)
Capabilities, part 2: matrix-op layouts, vector unit, shared memory, cross-lane, scheduling, occupancy, atomics
Distributed tiles, refinements: transposing shared loads and block-variant matrix ops
Cross-lane reductions and broadcasts on distributed tiles
Vector-unit selection: packed math, paired conversions, exp2 folding, reciprocal, dot product
Kernel-attributes pass: work-group size, waves per SIMD, accumulator budget, scheduling strategy
Uniform scalarisation: block-table and length reads on the scalar path
Atomic accumulate and native atomics at the stated scope
Attention prefill: diagonal-only masking, log-sum-exp, merge generator, lazy rescaling
Decode attention v2: grouped-query packing on the matrix op, split-KV
Split-K GEMM
Capability microbenchmarks: measure what no AMD document states
ROCm device description and the planner's device fields
Pinned host staging buffers and copy classes
Sluice on pinned staging buffers with asynchronous uploads
Priority streams and the HIP and HSA environment in the version manifest
Wave ping-pong and specialisation pass
Device and host state in tune and GPU test records
Low-precision attention: fp8 with block scales, Hadamard rotation
Persistent and stream-K kernels, cooperative launch, work-group flags
Multi-GPU memory: peer access, per-buffer peer mapping, signal words, Sluice fan-out
Launch overhead: per-iteration metadata path, argument preload, host wait mode
Exponential implementation options: polynomial and split
Background device-to-device copies off the compute units; batched small copies
Sluice: registered page-cache upload option
Device timestamps and compute-die ids per work group
Instruction-cache size in the capability query and the resource report
CU-masked streams
Partition-aware multi-instance placement
MX attention: MXFP8 and MXFP4 query and key on the scaled matrix op
GPU test: device description on gfx950 (PR #112)
GPU test: pinned staging, Sluice copy streams, priority streams on gfx950 (PRs #110, #113, #115)
GPU test: MXFP4 GEMM, MXFP4 KV and MX transforms on gfx950 (PR #118)
GPU test: R1 end-to-end acceptance run on gfx950, TinyLlama-1.1B (PR #119)
Pre-tiled weights: weights stored at load in the matrix unit's operand layout
Parallel tuning across GPUs: rustinfer tune --devices
GPU test: tune --devices on the 8× MI350X node (#123)
Profiler: target-independent, zero cost when off (Chrome trace, per-kernel summary)
GPU test: reference kernel times on the R1 keys (AITER / hipBLASLt baseline for RI-NFR-006)
